system.description:
Survival is knowledge of terrain, shelter, water, hunting, and edible and poisonous plants and fungi. Though a vampire needs only blood, Survival makes hunting animals easier and provides a safer existence for those who travel outside the cities.

Hunting and avoiding wilderness danger usually relies on a Physical Challenge, but with Survival you may substitute your Mental Traits. As a measure of ruggedness, it can also be used for retests of the Fortitude and Protean Disciplines.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
